narr: 5-hafta grammatika ish varag'idagi mashqlar bilan tanishamiz. Bu mashqlar o'tgan zamondagi oddiy passiv, hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv, will passiv va present perfect passiv turlarini o'rganishga qaratilgan.
Har bir mashqda berilgan misollar va javoblar kaliti bilan birga keladi.

data.heading: 1-mashq — O'tgan zamondagi oddiy passiv
data.problem: Gapni qavs ichidagi fe'lning o'tgan zamondagi oddiy passiv (past simple passive) shakli bilan to'ldiring. Misol: In ancient times, fires (light) were lit to use smoke as a signal over long distances.
steps: Morse code (invent) ___ by an American called Samuel Morse.
The world's first television images (show) ___ to scientists in Scotland in 1926.
Radios (use) ___ to broadcast coded messages during the Second World War.
The World Wide Web (design) ___ originally to make it easier for nuclear physics researchers to communicate.
Buying books and CDs over the Internet (make) ___ popular by the company Amazon.
The first mobile phones with cameras (sell) ___ in Japan.

narr: Birinchi mashqda o'tgan zamondagi oddiy passiv shaklini o'rganamiz. Bu shaklda harakat o'tgan vaqtda amalga oshirilgan va noma'lum yoki muhim bo'lmagan agent tomonidan bajarilganligini bildiradi.
Misol uchun, Morse kodini ixtiro qilgan agent Samuel Morse, shuning uchun javob 'was invented' bo'ladi.
Televizion tasvirlar ko'rsatilganligi uchun 'were shown' dan foydalanamiz.
Ikkinchi jahon urushi davrida radiolar foydalanilgani uchun 'were used' shakli to'g'ri.
World Wide Web dastlab yadro fiziklari uchun aloqani osonlashtirish uchun yaratilgan, shuning uchun 'was designed'.
Internet orqali kitoblar va CD sotib olish Amazon tomonidan mashhur qilingan, shuning uchun 'was made' dan foydalanamiz.
Yaponiyada birinchi kamerali mobil telefonlar sotilganligi uchun 'were sold' shakli to'g'ri.

data.heading: 1-mashq — O'tgan zamondagi oddiy passiv (cont.)
steps: Vinyl albums and tapes (replace) ___ by CDs, which are now being replaced by mp3.
The first English dictionary (write) ___ by Robert Cawdrey in 1604.
The first mass-produced cars (introduce) ___ by the Ford company in the USA.
data.result: Javob: (b) was invented; (c) were shown; (d) were used; (e) was designed; (f) was made; (g) were sold; (h) were replaced; (i) was written; (j) were introduced. Har bir gap tugallangan o'tgan voqeani bayon qiladi, shuning uchun shakl was/were + past participle bo'ladi (6-qoida).

narr: Vinyl albomlar va lentalar CD lar bilan almashtirilgan, shuning uchun 'were replaced'.
Robert Cawdrey tomonidan yozilgan birinchi ingliz lug'ati uchun 'was written' shakli to'g'ri.
Ford tomonidan AQShda taqdim etilgan birinchi mass ishlab chiqarilgan avtomobillar uchun 'were introduced' dan foydalanamiz.

data.heading: 2-mashq — "How a toy car is made" (Hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv)
data.problem: Matnni o'qing va barcha ega, fe'l va to'ldiruvchi tuzilmalarini tagiga chiziq bilan belgilang. So'ngra matnni present simple passive fe'llari yordamida qayta yozing. Keraksiz so'zlarni tashlab yuboring. Misol: As a first step, a computer is used to plan the exact shape of the car.
steps: Matn (so'zma-so'z): In the factory, they use a computer to plan the exact shape of the car. They then feed this computer program into a machine, and produce a plastic prototype. Then they produce the actual toy cars in a factory abroad. As far as construction is concerned, they make the bodies of the cars from plastic. They add small electric motors to the cars, and then they paint them. They also attach licence plates. Quality control inspects the cars and then they wrap them and pack them into cardboard boxes. They ship the cars to Britain.

Javob: (a) As a first step, a computer is used to plan the exact shape of the car. (berilgan) (b) This computer program is then fed into a machine, and a plastic prototype is produced. (c) The actual toy cars are produced in a factory abroad. (d) The bodies of the cars are made from plastic (as far as construction is concerned). (e) Small electric motors are added to the cars, and then they are painted; licence plates are also attached. (f) At the next stage, the cars are inspected by quality control, and then they are wrapped and packed into cardboard boxes. (g) Finally, the cars are shipped to Britain.
data.result: Umumiy 'they' egasi keraksiz bo'lgani uchun tashlab yuborilgan (2c-qoida).

narr: Ikkinchi mashqda hozirgi zamondagi oddiy passiv shaklini o'rganamiz. Bu shaklda harakat hozirgi vaqtda amalga oshirilayotganligini va noma'lum yoki muhim bo'lmagan agent tomonidan bajarilayotganligini bildiradi.
Matnni o'qib, ega, fe'l va to'ldiruvchi tuzilmalarini aniqlashimiz kerak.
Keyin matnni present simple passive fe'llari yordamida qayta yozamiz va keraksiz so'zlarni, ayniqsa umumiy 'they' egasini tashlab yuboramiz.
Masalan, 'they use a computer' o'rniga 'a computer is used' deb yozamiz.
Xuddi shunday, 'they feed this computer program' o'rniga 'this computer program is fed' shaklini qo'llaymiz.
Oxirgi jumlada 'they ship the cars' o'rniga 'the cars are shipped' deb yozamiz.

data.heading: 3-mashq — "the Freedom Ship" (Will passiv yoki present perfect passiv)
data.problem: Matnni qavsdagi fe'llarning will passiv yoki present perfect passiv shakllaridan biri bilan to'ldiring. Misol: In recent years many plans (make) have been made for large floating cities with living accommodation for as many as 50,000 people.
steps: Matn (so'zma-so'z, bo'sh joylar bilan): One such project which b (advertise) ___ is the Freedom Ship. According to the plans for this project, this huge ship c (construct) ___ from smaller units, which d (take) ___ out to sea for final assembly. The ship e (power) ___ by 100 diesel engines, and the residents on board f (carry) ___ around the world continuously. The large number of people on the ship g (provide) ___ with all kinds of food, entertainment and sports facilities, and modern recycling methods h (use) ___ to save energy on board. At the time of writing, this project i (not build) ___, and j (criticize) ___ by some people who say it is too expensive. We shall have to wait and see whether this ambitious plan ever becomes reality.

Javob: (b) has been advertised; (c) will be constructed; (d) will be taken; (e) will be powered; (f) will be carried; (g) will be provided; (h) will be used; (i) has not been built; (j) has been criticized.
data.result: Yozilayotgan paytda allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan reja-rejalar present perfect passive oladi; kema qurilgandan keyin ro'y beradigan hamma narsa will passive oladi.

narr: Uchinchi mashqda will passiv va present perfect passiv shakllarini o'rganamiz.
Yozilayotgan paytda allaqachon mavjud bo'lgan reja-rejalar present perfect passive oladi, masalan 'has been advertised' va 'has been criticized'.
Kema qurilgandan keyin ro'y beradigan hamma narsa will passive oladi, masalan 'will be constructed', 'will be taken', 'will be powered' va hokazo.
Bu shakl kelajakdagi harakatlar yoki rejalarni ifodalaydi, ular hali amalga oshirilmagan, lekin rejalashtirilgan.
Shuningdek, amalga oshirilgan harakatlar natijasida kelajakda ro'y beradigan jarayonlar ham will passive dan foydalaniladi.

data.heading: 4-mashq — "by" bilan present perfect passive
data.problem: Gapni "by" bilan present perfect passive ishlatib qayta yozing. Keraksiz so'zlarni tashlab yuboring. Misol: Cheaper air travel has made possible the global expansion in tourism. →The global expansion in tourism has been made possible by cheaper air travel.
steps: Countries all over the world have experienced a growth in tourism.
Millions of tourists have visited the popular Mediterranean resorts since the 1970s.
Recently tourists have chosen more distant locations in Africa, Asia and South America.
Mass tourism has badly affected some countries.
International companies have built large hotels on unspoilt coastline.
data.result: Javob: b. A growth in tourism has been experienced by countries all over the world. c. The popular Mediterranean resorts have been visited by millions of tourists since the 1970s. d. More distant locations in Africa, Asia and South America have been chosen by tourists recently. e. Some countries have been badly affected by mass tourism. f. Large hotels have been built on unspoilt coastline by international companies.

narr: To'rtinchi mashqda present perfect passive shaklini "by" agent bilan qo'llashni o'rganamiz.
Bu shaklda harakatning bajaruvchisini agent sifatida ko'rsatamiz.
Misol uchun, 'Countries all over the world have experienced a growth in tourism' gapini 'A growth in tourism has been experienced by countries all over the world' deb qayta yozamiz.
Xuddi shunday, 'Millions of tourists have visited the popular Mediterranean resorts' gapini 'The popular Mediterranean resorts have been visited by millions of tourists' deb yozamiz.
Bu shakl harakatning bajaruvchisini ta'kidlashga imkon beradi va matnni boshqacha usulda ifodalashga yordam beradi.
